title: TrustBridge Action Inputs
description: JSON Schema for trustbridge-action inputs. Mirrors action.yml. Use this schema to validate .trustbridge.yml config files or CI policy checks before runtime. See docs/SCHEMA.md for usage guidance.

github_token.description: GitHub token used to post issue comments. Requires `issues: write` permission.

github_app_token.description: Optional GitHub App installation token used instead of GITHUB_TOKEN for organization-wide triage or cross-repo comments (Issue #225).

stellar_address_input.description: Stellar account address (G-address, 56 characters) to validate. Required unless assignee_address_map is set.

assignee_address_map.description: Inline JSON object or path to a JSON file mapping GitHub usernames to Stellar G-addresses.

horizon_url.description: Stellar Horizon API base URL. Must be an HTTPS URL targeting a public Stellar network endpoint. Private/local IP addresses are blocked (SSRF guard).

horizon_url_fallback.description: Optional fallback Horizon API base URL. When the primary URL fails with a retryable error, TrustBridge retries against this URL.

rpc_fallback_url.description: Comma-separated secondary Horizon or RPC URLs to fail over to if the primary node fails.

asset_code.description: Asset code for trustline verification (e.g. USDC, EURC).

asset_issuer.description: Issuer address for the asset. Must be a Stellar G-address (classic issuer) or C-address (Soroban contract). Strictly validated against StrKey policy.

min_xlm_reserve.description: Minimum native XLM balance required. Applied as a floor over the Stellar protocol minimum.

min_trustline_limit.description: Minimum trustline limit required for the configured asset. Leave empty to skip this check.

min_asset_balance.description: Minimum balance required for the configured asset. Leave empty to skip this check.

fail_on_missing.description: When true, fails the workflow step on check failures. When false, emits a warning only.

debug_mode.description: Enable extra action logs and append an expert diagnostics block to the issue comment for troubleshooting.

sticky_comment.description: Update TrustBridge's previous issue comment instead of posting a new one each run.

onboarding_checklist.description: Include an onboarding checklist in the issue comment.

wait_until_funded.description: Poll Horizon until the account becomes funded instead of failing on the first 404.

wait_until_funded_timeout_ms.description: Maximum time to poll for funding in milliseconds (0–600000). Only used when wait_until_funded is true.

wait_until_funded_interval_ms.description: Delay between funding polls in milliseconds (1000–60000). Only used when wait_until_funded is true.

horizon_cache_ttl_ms.description: TTL for the in-memory Horizon account cache in milliseconds. Set to 0 to disable. Max 3600000.

use_cache.description: Cache successful Horizon account responses in job memory.

allow_cross_network_fallback.description: Allow the fallback URL to resolve to a different Stellar network than the primary. Off by default.

log_inputs.description: Emit a redacted JSON log record of all resolved action inputs at run start.

trustbridge_config_path.description: Path to a consumer trustbridge.yml config file. Leave empty to skip.

milestone_allowlist.description: Comma-separated allowlist of allowed milestone names. Empty disables the gate.

milestone_fail_on_skip.description: Fail the workflow when the milestone gate skips validation.

assets_json.description: JSON array of additional assets to validate trustlines for.

sep0007_deep_links.description: Emit SEP-0007 wallet deep links (web+stellar:pay) in the issue comment.

sep0007_origin_domain.description: Optional origin domain embedded in SEP-0007 URIs for wallet validation (SEP-0007 §3.4).

auto_wallet_labels.description: Automatically apply a wallet state label to the issue after each check run.

pass_label.description: Optional label to apply when the TrustBridge check passes. Leave empty to disable.

fail_label.description: Optional label to apply when the TrustBridge check fails. Leave empty to disable.

max_retries.description: Maximum number of retry attempts for Horizon API requests.

retry_base_delay_ms.description: Base delay in milliseconds for exponential backoff on Horizon retries.

retry_max_delay_ms.description: Maximum backoff delay in milliseconds for Horizon retries.

horizon_max_requests.description: Global cap on Horizon requests per run to prevent 429 stampedes. 0 for unlimited.

snooze_window_minutes.description: Time window in minutes to suppress duplicate failure comments. 0 disables snoozing.

force_comment.description: Bypass snooze logic and force an immediate comment post.

webhook_url.description: Optional HTTPS URL to POST a signed webhook notification to after every validation run. Must be HTTPS. Disabled by default.

webhook_secret.description: Shared HMAC-SHA256 secret for signing webhook payloads. Included as X-TrustBridge-Signature header. Never logged. Only used when webhook_url is set.

webhook_timeout_ms.description: Timeout in milliseconds for webhook delivery. On timeout the request is aborted and a warning is logged. Comment posting is unaffected.

webhook_auth_mode.description: Authentication mechanism for dashboard webhook notifications: hmac or oidc.

webhook_oidc_audience.description: Expected audience for GitHub OIDC token when webhook_auth_mode is oidc.

network_passphrase.description: Expected Stellar network passphrase for network identity verification.

check_ledger_freshness.description: Enable ledger freshness guard — warns or fails when Horizon is serving stale data.

max_ledger_lag_seconds.description: Maximum allowed lag in seconds between latest ledger close time and wall clock.

ledger_freshness_fail_on_stale.description: Hard-fail when Horizon is stale. Default is warn-only.

docs_base_url.description: Optional base URL for FAQ/docs deep links embedded in failing check bullets. Must be HTTPS. Defaults to the repo's docs/FAQ.md. (Issue #104)

network.description: Stellar network shorthand: testnet, public, or mainnet. Overrides horizon_url, asset_code, and asset_issuer defaults via campaign preset. (Issue #207)

preset.description: Campaign preset name (testnet, public, testnet-usdc, mainnet). Overrides network input and provides horizon_url, asset_code, asset_issuer defaults. (Issue #207)

comment_mode.description: Comment posting mode: post, dry-run, or off.

dashboard_webhook_url.description: Optional dashboard webhook URL for dry-run / Wave #38 harness.

stellar_toml_fetch_enabled.description: Enable optional SEP-0001 stellar.toml fetch and validation.

stellar_toml_cache_ttl_ms.description: TTL in milliseconds for cached stellar.toml lookups.

stellar_toml_hash_pin.description: Optional integrity hash for stellar.toml validation, format algorithm:hexvalue.

home_domain_check_mode.description: Home domain check mode: warn or strict.

locale.description: Language for issue comments. Supported: en, es, pt. Invalid falls back to en.

stellar_addresses.description: Newline-separated or JSON array of Stellar addresses for batch validation.

auto_wallet_labels.description: Automatically apply a wallet state label to the issue after each check run.

use_actions_cache_backend.description: Enable GitHub Actions cache backend persistence (true/false) to share cached Horizon responses across matrix legs.

write_validation_json.description: When true, write the validation result to validation_json_path as a machine-readable JSON artifact.

validation_json_path.description: File path where the validation result JSON is written when write_validation_json is true.

trustbridge_plugins_path.description: Comma-separated list of workspace-relative paths to external CheckPlugin modules to load and register.

sarif_output_path.description: Path to write SARIF 2.1.0 output file for GitHub Advanced Security integration.

use_plugin_runner.description: Use the plugin-based check pipeline instead of the monolith runAccountChecks.

unassign_on_not_ready.description: Automatically unassign the GitHub assignee(s) when readiness checks fail (ready is false). Defaults to false (opt-in).

project_id.description: Optional GitHub Projects v2 ID (node ID) to update item status when validation passes or fails.

project_status_field.description: Name of the status field in the GitHub Projects v2 board.

project_status_pass.description: Value/option to set on the project status field when validation passes.

project_status_fail.description: Value/option to set on the project status field when validation fails.

project_token.description: Optional GitHub token with project or write:org scope to use for Projects v2 updates.

claimable_balance_policy.description: How to treat claimable balances when determining funded status: ignore (default) or count (surface claimable hint, extra Horizon request only when count).

sep0010_challenge_xdr.description: Optional base64 XDR of a SEP-0010 challenge transaction to display in the comment (truncated, does not block ready).

sep0010_dashboard_url.description: Optional HTTPS dashboard URL where Freighter SEP-0010 proof can be verified (preferred over raw XDR, does not block ready).
